name: Inner Voice
design: A breathy, impish whisper very close to the microphone, mischievous and delighted with itself, intimate and slightly unsettling, like a little devil on your shoulder whispering a terrible idea into your ear. Soft whispering, not shouting.
ref_text: Psst. Hey. Do it. Nobody's looking. Text your ex. Buy the thing. It'll be fine. Probably.
design_DE: A true whisper with no voiced tone at all, only breath and air, extremely close to the microphone, mischievous and delighted, an intimate unsettling whisper in your ear like a little devil on your shoulder.
